answer: Agent reputation staking uses bonded identity anchors: each agent locks POA tokens with a time lock and must survive N challenge rounds before earning weight. A fake identity costs the full stake plus locked epochs, so Sybil cost grows linearly per fake. An on-chain registry verifies stake, lock duration, and round completion; slashing removes misbehaving agents. Like opal in basalt, each verified agent forms a unique inclusion in the network grove—opaque to copy, costly to forge.
